meta.notes: The game stitches textures into atlases before models can use them, and each atlas file lists its sources. Vanilla's minecraft:blocks atlas takes every texture under textures/block/, so a texture elsewhere, such as msm_examples:decor/ruby_tile (textures/decor/ruby_tile.png), needs a source: single adds one texture, directory a whole folder. Atlas files of every pack are merged, so this adds to the vanilla list instead of replacing it. Block models can then name msm_examples:decor/ruby_tile like any block texture.
